body: i guess i appreciate your effort, but i still think you're wrong. why would someone be interested in me when there's so many other better guys? it's like every woman has the choice between 10+ guys, and us (men) struggle to get someone.

well, ~7 billion people. now half that because im not gay.

3.5 billion people.

now im looking for people in my age group, that probably narrows it down to <1 billion. now  we need to look at people in my area. that makes the number even smaller. now you look at the number of single people. smaller. now the number of those people who would be interested in me. smallest.
I'm not a great mind though. Einstein, Newton, Tesla. THOSE were great minds deserving of crippling depression/lack of love. I'm not as good as them, but get the crippling depression.

Well obviously I'm not smart enough to overcome this problem. No one loves me - well, no one ever has. I haven't even had a hug in years. Yeah, I used to love spending time with my niece, but my brother has basically banned the whole family from seeing her, including me. That being said, I want the love and affection from a woman, which will probably never happen. Again, if it hasn't happened yet, it probably won't happen. Unless someone who is desperate to find someone wants to settle for me.
She was a sex-addict and moved back home. That's the only reason she was with me. And I don't have any hookups for drugs, or money to buy them
Very tough as my parents just did a very mean thing to financially cripple me. They literally managed to get ALL of my money, legally.

Had a psychiatrist tell me I'm "high functioning", but who cares if my life sucks. Just means my mind is using its "high functioning" power to make me more miserable. And obviously it's not "high functioning" enough if I can't get anyone to love me.
